title: Horizontal factorization of the specified product exchange
statement: For compactifications cf,cg, finite commutative A and every unbounded derived object M on X, the specified B0 equals P_k(A0) followed by rho_F followed by R_v(beta). The objects and all compositors are those of def-pur-product-exchange-coordinate-data. No boundedness or proper exchange invertibility is assumed.

source.place: Symmetry paragraph, reduction to proper maps, expanded by product-coordinate node Steps 3--8; Stacks Tags 09BN, 0E47 and 0F7J.

proof.text: Apply ordinary horizontal mate pasting to the proper factor cf.g with base maps cg.g and cg.i. The canonical pullback isomorphisms and cg.comm identify the rectangle with base change by g, giving proper exchange along g as P_k(A0) followed by exchange for the open square.

Use normalized restriction to identify that second exchange with rho_F. Expand compactification-relative exchange. Its last factor is R_v of canonical open base change; the open-unit normalization and pullback compositor identify that factor with beta.

theorem productHorizontalExchangeFactorization
    {B X Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ B} {g : Z ⟶ B}
    (cf : Compactification f) (cg : Compactification g)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (M : ProperOpenDerived (ULift.{u + 1} A) X) :
    B0 cf cg A M =
      (ProperOpenPull (ULift.{u + 1} A) cg.i).map (A0 cf cg A M) ≫
        (rho A (pullback.snd cf.g g) (i cf cg) cg.i
          (pullback.snd cf.g cg.g) (square cf cg)).hom.app (F cf cg A M) ≫
        (ProperOpenPush (ULift.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd cf.g g)).map
          (beta cf cg A M).hom
